description: Guess the secret number between 1 and 100 — with hot/cold hints, attempt tracking and three difficulty ranges.

faqs.a: Easy (1–50), Classic (1–100) or Hard (1–1000). Harder ranges give you more attempts.
After each guess you are told 'too high' or 'too low', plus a hot/warm/cold proximity hint.
Your fewest-attempts record per difficulty is saved in this browser.

howto: Pick a difficulty and press New game.
Follow the higher/lower and hot/cold hints.
Find the number in as few tries as you can!
title: Guess the Number Game
